note: Original concise classification rules; linked references are supporting sources, not imported databases. Plant status includes mineral and synthetic materials without identified animal content. Not a full ingredient taxonomy.

extendedMatching.note: Animal aliases also match as whole words inside longer composition terms, and compound stems match inside concatenated words such as German or Swedish compounds. Plant exceptions are removed from a term before that extended check so plant products are never vetoed. Terms with negations, substitutes, imitations or flavour words only match exactly.
